tool_activity.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '*' . && printf '%s\\n' '--- TASK.md ---' && sed -n '1,240p' TASK.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- materials ---' && rg --files materials | sort | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo --- \""'$0"; sed -n "1,240p" "$0"'"'"
/bin/bash -c "wc -l TASK.md materials/*.py materials/*.rst candidate.py && sed -n '1,120p' response-schema.json"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1120,1215p' materials/core.py && sed -n '2580,2665p' materials/core.py && sed -n '262,305p' materials/standard.py && sed -n '2110,2205p' materials/core.py"
/bin/bash -c "git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; stat -c '%n %s bytes' candidate.py TASK.md"
/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"TRITON_MAX_TENSOR_NUMEL|def reduce|def sum\\(|def load\\(|def store\\(|atomic_add|num_warps\" materials/core.py materials/standard.py | head -160"

reason: Tuned the fixed 1,048,576-element mean to 32 unmasked 32K-element Triton partial reductions with 16 warps and a single-warp final reduction, using a compile-time reciprocal.
